description: Use when you need candidate manufacturers or suppliers for a product or category. Candidate manufacturers/suppliers for a product or category requirement, from Wikidata manufacturer and industry/product relations, with curated categories for robotics, drones/UAV, industrial machinery and sensors/IoT (optional sector and country filters). Source-attributed and confidence-scored; no prices or stock. PAID tool: call without x402_payment to get the payment requirements. Price: $0.25 per call. Paid in REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453) via x402.

country.description: Optional ISO alpha-2 country filter (Wikidata country).

requirement.description: Product or category requirement, e.g. 'stainless steel water bottle manufacturers'.

sector.description: Optional sector for curated category mapping.

trial.description: Free trial instead of payment: a few calls per client per UTC day (shared across paid tools); result marked mode=trial.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 v1 'exact' EIP-3009 payment payload for Base mainnet (REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453)). Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements as a tool error (structuredContent.accepts); sign them and call again with this argument. One payment funds exactly one call.
